title: 上线后，护城河藏在业务流程里
series: The Founder's Playbook - Building an AI-Native Startup
mission: Explain that scale-stage defensibility comes from accumulated workflow-specific context, not generic model access.
audience: AI-native startup founders who have moved past MVP and are thinking about defensibility.

timing.audioStrategy: qwen chunk sequence with measured pauses

visualSystem.motionRule: one forward pass through the workflow-moat context; no repeated group in/out loops inside a semantic context
visualSystem.focusRule: highlight the active entity or connection for each chunk; dim non-focus options without removing them
visualSystem.backgroundRule: slow natural light drift only; background motion remains secondary to content

scenes.narration: 很多人讲 AI 创业的护城河，第一反应是：我用了哪个模型。
scenes.subtitle: 讲护城河，别只看用了哪个模型。

artifact.keyMessage: Model access is not enough for defensibility.

scenes.focusCue: highlight the model-access card, then show it as insufficient
scenes.motion: single reveal of model access comparison
scenes.sourceLogic: Source positions Scale-stage defensibility around accumulated workflow specificity, not a generic model claim.

scenes.claim: 模型权限本身，很难防守。
scenes.narration: 但到规模化阶段，模型权限本身很难成为护城河。别人也能接入相似的能力。
scenes.subtitle: 模型权限本身，很难成为护城河。

artifact.keyMessage: Similar model access does not create durable separation.

scenes.motion: continue same model-access context; no scene group reset
scenes.sourceLogic: Keeps the claim conditional and avoids unsupported named moat examples.

scenes.claim: 差距来自流程里沉淀的细节。
scenes.narration: 真正开始拉开差距的，是业务流程里一层一层沉淀下来的细节。
scenes.subtitle: 差距来自业务流程里沉淀的细节。

artifact.keyMessage: Workflow-specific detail becomes the strategic asset.

scenes.focusPhrase: 业务流程里一层一层沉淀
scenes.focusCue: highlight the workflow spine and first accumulated layer
scenes.motion: start a single forward stack reveal
scenes.sourceLogic: EP05 series note frames defensibility as specificity accumulated through workflow depth.

scenes.claim: 行业例外和用户行为，会进入系统。
scenes.narration: 比如，你知道这个行业的例外情况；你的系统接住了真实用户的行为。
scenes.subtitle: 行业例外、用户行为，开始进入系统。

artifact.keyMessage: Specificity begins with exceptions and observed behavior.

scenes.focusCue: highlight domain exception layer, then user behavior layer
scenes.sourceLogic: Uses only source-supported categories: domain knowledge and proprietary behavioral data.

scenes.claim: 工具集成和协作痕迹，也会沉淀。
scenes.narration: 你的流程连上了客户原来的工具，也留下了真实协作的痕迹。
scenes.subtitle: 流程接入工具，也留下协作痕迹。

artifact.keyMessage: Integrations and collaboration traces deepen workflow specificity.

scenes.focusPhrase: 连上了客户原来的工具
scenes.sourceLogic: Uses source-supported integration and workflow-depth defensibility categories.

scenes.claim: 提示词和模型，复制不了业务记忆。
scenes.narration: 这些东西不是一句提示词，也不是换一个模型就能复制。
scenes.subtitle: 这些不是换个模型就能复制。

artifact.keyMessage: Operational memory is harder to copy than model access.

scenes.focusCue: dim prompt/model cards and highlight operational memory
scenes.sourceLogic: Careful paraphrase of accumulated specificity and workflow depth as defensibility.

scenes.narration: 它们会变成上下文、数据、集成、习惯，最后变成切换成本。
scenes.subtitle: 上下文、数据、集成、习惯，会变成切换成本。

artifact.keyMessage: Accumulated workflow assets may become switching cost.

scenes.focusCue: highlight the final switching-cost node after chain reveal
scenes.motion: continue copy-gap context into asset chain
scenes.sourceLogic: Directly reflects source-supported defensibility mechanisms: context, data, integrations, lock-in.

scenes.claim: 不要只问：我们是不是用了 AI？
scenes.narration: 所以，这一集不要问：我们是不是用了 AI？
scenes.subtitle: 不要只问：我们是不是用了 AI？

artifact.keyMessage: Generic AI adoption is the wrong audit question.

scenes.focusCue: show the wrong question and dim it
scenes.sourceLogic: Turns the Scale-stage source model into a founder audit question.

scenes.claim: 要问：系统沉淀了什么独特业务细节？
scenes.narration: 要问：我们的 AI 系统里，沉淀了哪些只有我们才有的业务细节？
scenes.subtitle: 要问：系统里沉淀了哪些独特业务细节？

artifact.keyMessage: Audit the unique workflow detail accumulating inside the AI system.

scenes.focusPhrase: 只有我们才有的业务细节
scenes.sourceLogic: Preserves the source logic while avoiding unsupported certainty.

scenes.claim: 规模化以后，护城河可能长在工作流里。
scenes.narration: 这才是 AI-native 公司在规模化以后，可能长出护城河的地方。
scenes.subtitle: 工作流里，才可能长出护城河。

artifact.keyMessage: At Scale, workflow-specific accumulation may become defensibility.

scenes.focusCue: highlight Scale and conditional moat outcome
scenes.sourceLogic: Uses conditional moat language because the source supports mechanisms, not guaranteed outcomes.
